notes: Modified cash basis audit (FYE 9/30/2022). Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p5, Total column). Taxes 299,194 split from the General Fund (p15) and LB 840 Fund (p21) schedules; Intergovernmental 125,622, Charges for services 87,400 and Other 77,227 split from the fund schedules (pp15, 20, 21) with printed row labels; all sums exact. Governmental beginning cash not printed (no prior-year column); fund balances 627,659 / 468,250 from p5; ending_cash = Cash 459,951 + Cash held by county treasurer 8,299 (p3). Business-type from the modified cash proprietary statement (pp9-10; accrual versions pp23-26 not used, as in FY2023): insurance proceeds 9,974 printed among nonoperating revenues is a receipt; capital contributions Federal grants 51,680 in business_type.other_financing; transfers net (10,402); net position 3,065,898 -> 3,051,820 (ties). Proprietary cash flows null (modified cash report; later years null). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1), since it includes capital assets. Detail: General Fund (pp15-18; Loan principal/interest printed under Highway and Streets recorded as Debt Service, matching the statement's debt service lines), Lottery (p19), Economic Development by program (p20), LB 840 (p21) and the Municipal Utilities Fund by department, modified cash (p22). The combined all-fund-types budget and actual schedule (pp13-14) is not recorded (less detailed; different basis), as in FY2023. Lot sales 1,200 left in other (page does not say cemetery).
